value.text:
I have confirmed the three database driver implementations and the startup factory function.

The three driver implementations are entry files under `/bench/repo/store/db/`:

- `sqlite.go` — `NewDB`
- `postgres.go` — `NewDB`
- `mysql.go` — `NewDB`

The startup factory is `NewDBDriver` in `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go`. It is called from `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go`.

I will use full repository paths as required by the formatting rule.

q18.

/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go  
/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go  
/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/mysql.go  
NewDBDriver — /bench/repo/store/db/db.go

Each of the three entry files defines a `DB` type that implements `store.Driver` (declared in `/bench/repo/store/driver.go`) via its own `NewDB` constructor. At startup, `NewDBDriver` in `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go` switches on `profile.Driver` (`"sqlite"`, `"mysql"`, or `"postgres"`) and calls the matching `NewDB`; it is invoked from `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go`.
